description: Render an avatar GLB with a three.ws pose preset, camera orbit, and optional ARKit-52 facial expression. Same pipeline as the three.ws customizer's save-snapshot flow. Returns PNG bytes as a base64 data URL. Accepts either glbUrl directly or sessionId from spawn_avatar.

phi.description: Pitch in degrees, 0..180 (from top). Default 80 (slightly above eye-level).

radius.description: Distance in meters. null = auto-frame the bounding box.

expression.description: ARKit-52 morph target map, e.g. { mouthSmileLeft: 0.6, mouthSmileRight: 0.6 }.

glbUrl.description: Avatar GLB URL. Required if sessionId is omitted.

posePresetId.description: Pose preset id (e.g. "tpose", "wave", "thinker"). Call list_animations for the full catalog.

sessionId.description: Avatar session id from spawn_avatar. Overrides glbUrl.

name: render_avatar
title: Render a posed avatar (pose + camera + expression)
